acquisition_method: The Q-Exactive was operated in a data-dependent mode using Xcalibur v.2.2 (Thermo Fisher)
alkylation_concentration: Samples were reduced and alkylated by adding 6 μg of DTT and 15 μg of iodoacetamide and incubating at room temperature in the dark for 30 min and 20 min, respectively.
alkylation_reagent: Samples were reduced and alkylated by adding 6 μg of DTT and 15 μg of iodoacetamide and incubating at room temperature in the dark for 30 min and 20 min, respectively.
cleavage_agent: Three micrograms of LysC was added to each sample and incubated for 3 h at room temperature. Subsequently, samples were diluted with 4 volumes of Digestion Buffer (50 mM NH4HCO3) and trypsin (Promega) was added at a ratio of 1:50.
collision_energy: The Q-Exactive was operated in a data-dependent mode using Xcalibur v.2.2 (Thermo Fisher) and set to acquire a full-range scan at 70,000 resolution from 350 to 2000 Th (AGC target 3E6) and to fragment the top ten multiply charged ions above 5% underfill ratio by HCD (resolution 17,500, AGC target 1E5, maximum injection time 60 ms, NCE 28) in each cycle.
fractionation_method: Peptides from each biological replicate were then subjected to high pH reverse-phase (RP) fractionation on an Agilent 1100 HPLC system
fragmentation_method: fragment the top ten multiply charged ions above 5% underfill ratio by HCD (resolution 17,500, AGC target 1E5, maximum injection time 60 ms, NCE 28) in each cycle.
instrument: Purified peptides were analyzed using an Easy nano LC 1000 nanoflow HPLC (Thermo Fisher) on-line coupled to a Q-Exactive mass spectrometer (Thermo Fisher).
ionization_type: inferred: Purified peptides were analyzed using an Easy nano LC 1000 nanoflow HPLC (Thermo Fisher) on-line coupled to a Q-Exactive mass spectrometer (Thermo Fisher).
labeling: HeLa cells were cultured in ­DMEM (Lys/Arg−/−) supplemented with 10% dialyzed FBS (Invitrogen), 1× Pen-Strep, and combinations of the following lysine and arginine isotopologues: for “light” (“L”)-labeled cells, l-arginine (84 mg/L) and l-lysine (146 mg/L) (Sigma-Aldrich); for “medium” (“M”)-labeled cells, 13C6-l-arginine (87 mg/L) and D4-l-lysine (150 mg/L); and for “heavy” (“H”)-labeled cells, 13C615N4-l-arginine (89 mg/L) and 13C615N2-l-lysine (154 mg/L) (Cambridge Isotope Laboratories).
mass_analyzer: inferred: Purified peptides were analyzed using an Easy nano LC 1000 nanoflow HPLC (Thermo Fisher) on-line coupled to a Q-Exactive mass spectrometer (Thermo Fisher).
ptm: carbamidomethyl, methionine oxidation, deamidation (NQ), N-acetylation (protein N-terminus)
fixed modifications, carbamidomethyl; variable modifications, methionine oxidation, deamidation (NQ), and N-acetylation (protein N-terminus)
reduction_concentration: Samples were reduced and alkylated by adding 6 μg of DTT and 15 μg of iodoacetamide and incubating at room temperature in the dark for 30 min and 20 min, respectively.
reduction_reagent: Samples were reduced and alkylated by adding 6 μg of DTT and 15 μg of iodoacetamide and incubating at room temperature in the dark for 30 min and 20 min, respectively.
